sentences.text: On 1.31, validation ratcheting allows the API server to accept updates to resources that are not valid after the update, provided the parts that failed validation were not changed by the update operation.

citations.quote: the API server is willing to accept updates to resources that are not valid after the update, provided that each part of the resource that failed to validate was not changed by the update operation

The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover this.
